description: Get the list of cryptocurrencies supported for manual tracking. The `symbol` of an entry here is what must be passed to create_manual_crypto. The full list has well over a thousand entries, so pass `search` when looking for a specific coin.

search.description: Case-insensitive text matched against each coin's symbol, name, and CoinGecko id (e.g. 'eth' or 'cardano'). Exact symbol matches are listed first. Omit to return the full list.

name: get_supported_cryptocurrencies
